system.description: @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.NS2bhYMi23m0eWao]{Hillfolk} bands breed their horses for strength, agility, and courage, and the best of them become steeds for Hillfolk riders. It takes a firm hand and a steady will to handle an Upland — but win one over and you've got a friend for life.
